svg.title: US and Hong Kong books, measured apart
svg.desc: Us Book +30.17%, +US$752 on US$2,491 (true_principal). Hk Book −57.71%, −HK$63,244 on HK$109,597 (net_principal). Combined −44.41% in USD (mixed). Each return is total P&L (realized + unrealized) divided by the basis named under it; the bases differ and the currencies are not added. Daily total P&L per book from 2026-07-14 to 2026-11-16. Source: dashboard.json on the data plane.
